+	// only filled in when a route is found for the path but not for the
+	// request's method, so that the 405 response can name the methods that
+	// would have been served.
+	methodsAllowed []methodTyp
+
 	// methodNotAllowed hint
 	methodNotAllowed bool
 }
@@ -90,10 +97,27 @@ func (x *Context) Reset() {
 	x.routePattern = ""
 	x.routeParams.Keys = x.routeParams.Keys[:0]
 	x.routeParams.Values = x.routeParams.Values[:0]
+	x.methodsAllowed = x.methodsAllowed[:0]
 	x.methodNotAllowed = false
 	x.parentCtx = nil
 }
 
+// addMethodAllowed records a method that a route serves, keeping
+// methodsAllowed ordered by method type and free of repeats, so the Allow
+// header of a 405 reads the same on every request.
+func (x *Context) addMethodAllowed(m methodTyp) {
+	i := 0
+	for i < len(x.methodsAllowed) && x.methodsAllowed[i] < m {
+		i++
+	}
+	if i < len(x.methodsAllowed) && x.methodsAllowed[i] == m {
+		return
+	}
+	x.methodsAllowed = append(x.methodsAllowed, 0)
+	copy(x.methodsAllowed[i+1:], x.methodsAllowed[i:])
+	x.methodsAllowed[i] = m
+}

+package chi
+
+import (
+	"net/http"
+	"sort"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+)
+
+// CORSOptions configures the CORS middleware and the Mux#EnableCORS helpers.
+//
+// A zero value is usable: an empty AllowOrigin means "*", an empty
+// AllowMethods lists the methods the router serves for the requested path,
+// an empty AllowHeaders echoes the headers the preflight request asked for,
+// and a zero MaxAge leaves the Access-Control-Max-Age header out.
+type CORSOptions struct {
+	// AllowOrigin is the value of Access-Control-Allow-Origin, "*" by default.
+	AllowOrigin string
+
+	// AllowMethods is the value of Access-Control-Allow-Methods on a
+	// preflight response. When empty, the methods that the router has a
+	// handler for on the requested path are used instead.
+	AllowMethods []string
+
+	// AllowHeaders is the value of Access-Control-Allow-Headers on a
+	// preflight response.
+	AllowHeaders []string
+
+	// ExposeHeaders is the value of Access-Control-Expose-Headers, the
+	// response headers that browsers let scripts read.
+	ExposeHeaders []string
+
+	// MaxAge is the number of seconds a browser may cache a preflight
+	// response (Access-Control-Max-Age). Zero leaves the header out and a
+	// negative value tells the browser not to cache at all.
+	MaxAge int
+
+	// AllowCredentials sets Access-Control-Allow-Credentials to true.
+	AllowCredentials bool
+}
+
+// DefaultCORSOptions returns the options used by Mux#EnableCORS: any origin,
+// the headers APIs commonly receive and a preflight cache of one hour. The
+// allowed methods are left empty so they follow the routes of the router.
+func DefaultCORSOptions() CORSOptions {
+	return CORSOptions{
+		AllowOrigin:  "*",
+		AllowHeaders: []string{"Accept", "Authorization", "Content-Type", "X-CSRF-Token"},
+		MaxAge:       3600,
+	}
+}
+
+// CORS returns a middleware that sets the CORS response headers on every
+// response and answers every OPTIONS request itself, as a preflight, with
+// a 204 and the Access-Control-Allow-* headers, without calling the next
+// handler. A route's own OPTIONS handler therefore never runs behind it.
+func CORS(options CORSOptions) func(http.Handler) http.Handler {
+	return func(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
+		return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+			if r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
+				servePreflight(w, r, options)
+				return
+			}
+			setCORSHeaders(w, r, options)
+			next.ServeHTTP(w, r)
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+// corsMethodNotAllowed is the method-not-allowed handler that EnableCORS
+// installs. It answers a preflight that reached it (a route registered
+// without an OPTIONS handler), tells the caller which methods the path
+// does serve in the Allow header, and then lets previous, the handler it
+// replaced, write the 405 if there was one.
+func corsMethodNotAllowed(options CORSOptions, previous http.HandlerFunc) http.HandlerFunc {
+	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		if r.Method == http.MethodOptions {
+			servePreflight(w, r, options)
+			return
+		}
+		setCORSHeaders(w, r, options)
+		if methods := availableMethods(r); len(methods) > 0 {
+			w.Header().Set("Allow", strings.Join(methods, ", "))
+		}
+		if previous != nil {
+			previous(w, r)
+			return
+		}
